properties.otherAdvice:
A temporary pedestrian bridge will be built across Macquarie St to facilitate the safe movement of participants for the Sydney Marathon event on the weekend of 30-31 August.

Macquarie St will be closed between Bridge St and Bent St to allow for the installation and then removal of the temporary bridge. Once installed the bridge will have a height clearance of 5.2m.

Overnight full and/or lane closures will be in place at the following times:

  • Fri 22 Aug: Full closure from 11pm - 7am
  • Sat 23 Aug: One of two lanes will be closed in both directions from 11pm – 7am
  • Sun 31 Aug: Full closure from 6pm – 4am
  • Mon 1 Sep: Northbound lanes will be closed from 10pm - 2am

When full closures are in place motorists will be detoured via Bridge St, Phillip St and Bent St.

Some parking spaces will be removed from Macquarie St during bridge installation and removal.
